_comment: Two dispatchers racing for the same ticket. `race_claims` makes the fixture
client insert a COMPETING claim comment, with a lower comment id, at the
moment this dispatcher posts its own - the exact interleaving that a
read-then-write check cannot see. The election is decided by the
server-assigned comment id, so this dispatcher must lose, withdraw its
comment, spawn nothing, and leave the labels untouched.
#31 is the positive control: no competitor, so it must be dispatched. Without
it, 'nothing was dispatched' would pass the race test for the wrong reason.

issues.title: Contested ticket
body_lines: Two dispatch passes want this at the same instant.

issues.title: Uncontested ticket (positive control)
body_lines: Nobody else wants it, so it must be dispatched.
